a_rage_enrage.category: a: Warpaint/Sigil rage gain + enrage window
a_rage_enrage.why: Vengeful Sigil (Silver, Hand socket 0) is the source of 22 PlayerRageApply events; isolated repeats move the owner's rage by exactly +4, matching this card's RageApplyAmount 4 (9 isolated +4 steps, e.g. f81/f86/f91). The owner reaches 100 rage at f120 and enrages for exactly 100 frames (5.0 s, EnragedDuration 5000 = opening EnragedDurationMax); the enraged-only Lifesteal aura is applied at f120 and removed at f220.
evidence: Vengeful Sigil: observed -> when an opponent item is used -> PlayerRageApply; while enraged -> Lifesteal aura on own Weapons
Vengeful Sigil PlayerRageApply: f81 +4 (card RageApplyAmount=4, 1 concurrent), f86 +4 (card RageApplyAmount=4, 1 concurrent), f91 +4 (card RageApplyAmount=4, 1 concurrent)
enrage opponent: f120→f220 (5.00 s window, 5000 ms timer); f246→combat end (open, 5000 ms timer)
caveats: The first owner-side rage jump (0→27 at f61) is an aggregate of three PlayerRageApply events (not all Sigil); Sigil's own +4 steps start at f81.
Combatant-1 (visible board) is the card owner; the replay's 'Player' bucket is the hidden local board.

a_rage_enrage.category: a: Warpaint rage gain (no enrage window)
a_rage_enrage.why: Warpaint (Diamond, Hand socket 2, RageApplyAmount 12) is the source of a PlayerRageApply at f57; the owner's rage moves 0→20 that frame from two concurrent rage events, of which Warpaint contributes 12. Rage caps at 52, so no enrage window occurs and the Extended Rage card in the same replay is unexercised.
evidence: Warpaint: observed -> when the item to the left is used -> PlayerRageApply (RageApplyAmount)
Warpaint PlayerRageApply: f57 +20 (card RageApplyAmount=12, 2 concurrent)
first below half opponent: f160 (3919/9025 HP, shield None)
caveats: Aggregated frame: two PlayerRageApply events land in the same frame, so the +20 cannot be split from the attribute update alone; the per-event split comes from the event list (Warpaint 12 + another source 8).

b_shield_half.why: Only Burning Shield occurrence in the corpus. The skill is exercised as an aura value recalculation (19 CardModifyAttribute events), and its owner first drops below half health at f330 (1243/2635), but the defining first-below-half PlayerShieldApply never fires; the +40 shield at f332 comes from Blueberry Pie (30da8c8f), not from Burning Shield. Toxic Shield never appears.
evidence: Burning Shield: NOT observed -> first Health loss below 50% HealthMax -> PlayerShieldApply (Custom_1 x Burn on enemy)
first below half opponent: f330 (1243/2635 HP, shield 0)
caveats: Present-but-defining-mechanic-missed sample, not a positive validation.
Possible causes not distinguishable from the payload: zero-value shield suppressed, or the skill was disabled; there is no CardDisable event for the instance in the trace.

d_healthmax_pdr.why: Player-side PercentDamageReduction goes 0→50 at f72 together with Rage 69→100 and Enraged 0→1, and back to 0 at f172 when Enraged 1→0; a second identical window runs f248→348. This is the cleanest native evidence that PercentDamageReduction is a timed player attribute tied to the enrage window.
evidence: enrage player: f72→f172 (5.00 s window, 5000 ms timer); f248→f348 (5.00 s window, 5000 ms timer)
enrage opponent: f181→f261 (4.00 s window, 4000 ms timer); f311→f391 (4.00 s window, 4000 ms timer)
first below half opponent: f100 (3129/7894 HP, shield None)
caveats: The PDR source instance is on the hidden combatant-0 board (itm_3D8NdGi aura at f72, itm_eqhvflV at f251); the item identity cannot be resolved from the payload.
Shortened Rage is present on the opposing side and its owner enrages with a 4000 ms timer.

d_healthmax_pdr.why: Seven PlayerModifyAttribute (action 31) events from hidden skill skl_Gr7wIyD raise the player's HealthMax and Health by +50 each (7900→8250, f73…f193), giving a clean per-event HealthMax trigger trace.
evidence: Warpaint: observed -> when the item to the left is used -> PlayerRageApply (RageApplyAmount)
Warpaint PlayerRageApply: f57 +20 (card RageApplyAmount=12, 2 concurrent)
first below half opponent: f160 (3919/9025 HP, shield None)
caveats: Source skl_Gr7wIyD and trigger itm_Jdwcrbz are hidden-board instances; no focus card is involved.
Same replay is the only positive Warpaint sample, so it doubles as a HealthMax sample.

d_healthmax_pdr.category: d: HealthMax changes + Extended Rage timer
d_healthmax_pdr.why: Owner-side HealthMax changes via action 31: 3230→3403 (+173, Brass Knuckles), 3403→5403 (+2000, Karnok rage skill), then +192 and +198; the same side spawns with EnragedDurationMax 6000 (5000 + Custom_0 1000) and enrages at f101 with a 6000 ms timer, matching Extended Rage.
evidence: enrage opponent: f101→f221 (6.00 s window, 6000 ms timer)
first below half opponent: f261 (2779/5595 HP, shield 0)
caveats: HealthMax +2000 event is triggered by the Karnok's Rage skill, not by Extended Rage.

bonus_enrage_duration.why: Shortened Rage owner spawns with EnragedDurationMax 4000 (5000 − Custom_0 1000) and enrages at f198 with EnragedDuration 4000 ms, staying enraged exactly 80 frames (4.0 s); no 38 attribute delta is emitted in combat, so the aura value is folded into the opening attributes.
evidence: enrage opponent: f198→f278 (4.00 s window, 4000 ms timer)
first below half opponent: f220 (1601/4458 HP, shield 0)
caveats: The card itself emits no combat events; evidence is the opening attribute plus the timer at enrage start.

bonus_enrage_duration.why: Extended Rage owner spawns with EnragedDurationMax 6000 (5000 + Custom_0 1000) and enrages at f166 with EnragedDuration 6000 ms, staying enraged 120 frames (6.0 s); no 38 attribute delta is emitted in combat.
evidence: enrage opponent: f166→f286 (6.00 s window, 6000 ms timer)
first below half opponent: f260 (1135/3039 HP, shield 899)
